title: Name is required, up to 40 characters, and needs at least one member
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell and select the Tag groups tab. An active location is selected (the location name shown next to the bell; change it with your initials at the top right -> Change Location).
custom_steps:
1. In the Name field, try to type past 40 characters.
  2. With no member selected, read the confirm button ("Create" on new, "Save" on edit) and hover it.
  3. On an existing group, remove the last member and try to Save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Name is required and at most 40 characters - the field stops accepting input at 40 (it does not accept a longer value then reject on save).
  • Members is required (at least one); while no member is selected the confirm button is disabled ("Create" on a new group, "Save" on an edit) with the tooltip "Add at least one member.", and removing the last member of an existing group disables Save until a member is added - the member cannot be removed and saved away.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R8: “Name is required and is at most 40 characters. The field stops accepting input at 40; it does not accept a longer value and then reject it on save.”
  • S6-R26: “Members is required. A tag group holds at least one member.”
  • S6-R27: “While no member is selected, the dialog's confirm button is disabled: "Create" on a new group, "Save" on an edit.”
  • S6-R28: “Removing the last member of an existing group disables Save for as long as the group has no members. The member cannot be removed and saved away.”
  • S6-R29: “The disabled confirm button carries the tooltip "Add at least one member."”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
